```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(palmerpenguins)
library(ggthemes)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(leaflet)
```

# Graphs

## Column {width=65%}

```{r}
#| title: Graph 1
p1 <- ggplot(
  penguins,
  aes(x = body_mass_g, y = flipper_length_mm, col = species,
      text = paste0(species, ": ", body_mass_g, " g, ", flipper_length_mm, " mm"))
) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_colorblind() +
  labs(x = "Body mass (g)", y = "Flipper length (mm)", color = "Species")

ggplotly(p1, tooltip = "text")
```

## Column {width=35%}

```{r}
#| title: Graph 2
p2 <- ggplot(penguins, aes(x = flipper_length_mm, fill = species)) +
  geom_histogram(col = "white") +
  facet_wrap(vars(species)) +
  scale_fill_colorblind() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "Flipper length (mm)", y = "Count")

ggplotly(p2)
```

```{r}
#| title: Graph 3
p3 <- ggplot(penguins, aes(x = body_mass_g, fill = species)) +
  geom_histogram(col = "white") +
  facet_wrap(vars(species)) +
  scale_fill_colorblind() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "Body mass (g)", y = "Count")

ggplotly(p3)
```

# Map

```{r}
islands <- penguins |>
  count(island) |>
  left_join(
    tibble(
      island = c("Biscoe", "Dream", "Torgersen"),
      lat = c(-64.80, -64.73, -64.77),
      lng = c(-63.77, -64.23, -64.08)
    ),
    by = "island"
  )
```

## Column {width=25%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Biscoe"
#| icon: "geo-alt"
#| color: "primary"
list(value = islands$n[islands$island == "Biscoe"])
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Dream"
#| icon: "geo-alt"
#| color: "info"
list(value = islands$n[islands$island == "Dream"])
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Torgersen"
#| icon: "geo-alt"
#| color: "success"
list(value = islands$n[islands$island == "Torgersen"])
```

## Column {width=75%}

```{r}
#| title: Where the penguins live
leaflet(islands) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addMarkers(lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, popup = ~paste0(island, ": ", n, " penguins"))
```

# Data

Data were collected and made available by [Dr. Kristen Gorman](https://www.uaf.edu/cfos/people/faculty/detail/kristen-gorman.php) and the [Palmer Station, Antarctica LTER](https://pallter.marine.rutgers.edu), a member of the Long Term Ecological Research Network.

```{r}
datatable(penguins, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top") |>
  formatStyle(columns = colnames(penguins), fontSize = "14pt")
```
